receipts.title: TandemOperationReceipts
receipts.description: Tandem bounded operation receipts; schema contract 81/1. No participant direct writes.

parentBatchSchemaSnapshot.scope: One-time owner schema setup/audit; no business item writes, deletes or permission changes. Existing mismatches are reported, never silently converted.
parentBatchSchemaSnapshot.email: Excluded: approved mailbox failed REST capability probe; #49/#21 remains separate.

descriptionLimitKind: Technical plain-text API bound only, not a native Note schema setting or new product approval
sharedValidator: No normalization or matching needed; operation-time identity, operational membership, capacity, state and CAS only.

input.text: RequestJson object; required exact actorId, groupId, expectedETag, intentId UUID and edits. Both envelope and edits reject extra properties. All four edits Title/Purpose/Capacity/State are required; description may be empty.

editAllowlist.Title: Nonblank string, maximum255 characters; value preserved.
editAllowlist.Purpose: Plain text string, maximum2000 characters; empty allowed. Native blank Note readback coalesces to empty string; no native field limit changed.
editAllowlist.Capacity: Strict integer Language2/3, Culture/Combined2..10; never below ALL physical Active rows including provisional and paused participants.
editAllowlist.State: Exact Open/Closed/Ended; fresh edits only from Open/Closed; Ended final. No count-driven state changes.

authority: Same Invoker currentuser -> unique own ParticipantaccountId -> exact actorId; group SetupComplete plus Accepted/OperationComplete source; current physical Active membership -> exact canonical membership episode request, Accepted/OperationComplete and correct personal-source parties or Group target/sender. Repeat group/membership/request reads under exact-token guard. Personal ParticipationStatus, OpenToConnections and profile availability are not group-control authority.

outputs.success: Boolean, true only UPDATED or successful historical REPLAY after completion/release proof.
outputs.resultcode: UPDATED, REPLAY, or sanitized rejection/conflict/busy/unknown/setup failure.
outputs.resultjson: Versioned report; saved is immutable historical result, with original domain-write revision/member count; no receipt/owner/account fields.
outputs.groupjson: On success, current captured public group snapshot {groupId,title,purpose,capacity,state,etag}; independent of historical saved result.
outputs.etag: Same captured current group revision as groupjson, after release if performed. Use with that exact snapshot and refresh before a new deliberate edit.
outputs.errormessage: Sanitized text; unknown outcomes never claim no effect.

coordination.ownerToken: Compact serialized {operation: operationKey, attempt: fresh server guid()} in both WriteOwner and receipt AttemptToken; opaque to other writers, exact string comparison only.
coordination.frozenIntent: Typed {kind:update,actorId,groupId,expectedETag,edits}; native equals(json(stored IntentJson), frozen intent). Same key changed payload/revision conflicts.
coordination.writeOrder: receipt unique create/readback -> exact expected-ETag group claim/readback -> fresh group/member/episode proof/count -> conditional possible-effect marker -> exact-ETag allowlist edit/readback -> completed receipt/readback -> exact own-token group release/readback -> success. All writes retryPolicy none.
coordination.replay: Current authority required; completed exact receipt returns saved historical result, never repeats the edit. May release only its own exact saved old token; leaves a different current owner untouched.
coordination.knownNoDomainRejection: Persist completed Rejected receipt and release only a confirmed owned token. A changed group ETag with a different token positively rules out a late original CAS and permits terminal no-domain rejection without touching the foreign owner.
coordination.unknown: Incomplete receipt/uncertain write retains ownership and returns non-success; no timeout, lease takeover, auto retry or generic502-as-success. Completed receipt with failed release can finalize release on replay without another domain edit.
coordination.DomainEffects: Set true/Uncertain true conservatively BEFORE attempting the edit; this means effects may exist. Cleared to false on positively proven no-domain rejection; successful completed result has DomainEffects true/Uncertain false.

dependencyGates: Parent #81 performs one-time Setup Apply+Audit for the ten fields, unique/indexed OperationKey, plain JSON Notes, standard Title and exact unique list title before enabling business flows. Default resolves that title and works after setup without rebuild/reimport; optional actual GUID pin only if already available.
Existing #12 Groups/GroupMembers metadata remains unchanged; #19/#42 native Invoker/current-member data authority is still unverified for this flow.
All group capacity/state/membership writers must honor the same opaque nonempty WriteOwner guard and exact CAS rules.
Parent assembles native Solution/bindings and records #81/#13 ledger/issue evidence. No shared validator call is needed for capacity-only operation guards.

receiptResolution.oneImport: Import parent Solution once, run parent Setup Apply+Audit with business flows disabled, then enable/test the same imported flow. No GUID pin, regeneration or reimport required in default title mode.
